interface.description: Network interface to monitor (e.g., eth0, wlp3s0). Must be active and support packet capture.

bpf_filter.description: Berkeley Packet Filter (BPF) expression to filter traffic (e.g., 'host 192.168.1.1' or 'port 22'). Leave empty to monitor all traffic.

output_mode.description: Display mode for the host entries. Options: 'two-line' (default), 'one-line-both', 'one-line-sent', 'one-line-received'.

reverse_dns.description: Enable or disable reverse DNS lookups to display hostnames instead of raw IP addresses. Default is yes.

sort_by.description: Sort order for the host list. Options: '2s', '10s' (default), '40s', 'source', 'destination'.

color.description: Enable bar graphs. Disable for terminal compatibility or log files. Mapped to `show-bars`.

ignore_hosts.description: List of IP addresses or substrings to exclude from display. Mapped to `screen-filter` (as pipe-separated regex) in config.

promiscuous.description: Put the interface into promiscuous mode, so that traffic which does not pass directly through the specified interface is also counted.

port_display.description: Controls display of port numbers. Options: 'off', 'source-only', 'destination-only', 'on'.

use_bytes.description: Use bytes for bandwidth display, rather than bits.

link_local.description: Determines displaying of link-local IPv6 addresses.
